name: code-comes-back-from-the-atoms-of-its-records
query: #[1 :add :modifiers :name ::call ::quote] | with {:q /5 :c /4 :fields ~(get [[/2 [/0]] [/3 /1]] | indexBy ~(first) | map ~last)} ~(get [~(fields | tag c)] | tag q)

name: the-declaration-of-a-kind-comes-back-from-its-tag-and-payload
query: ::vec | binding | value | :d it | :t (tag) | payload | tag t | eq d

name: an-error-comes-back-from-the-atoms-of-its-facts
query: #[1 :k ::FooError ::error] | with {:outer /2 :inner /3 :facts ~(get [[/1 /0]] | indexBy ~(first) | map ~last)} ~(facts | tag inner | tag outer)
